title: S1e overhead: orchestration-overhead metric per accepted goal (amplification, cost share, latency share) from run rows, with scorecard --overhead (P23)
spec:
Create orchestrator/overhead.py. ORCHESTRATION_ROLES = ("planner","planner_decision","planner_shadow","scout","review","spec_review","challenge","jev_route","jev_gate","jev_sched","jev_points","jev_rank","jev_skills","memory","routing","env_policy"); EXECUTION_ROLES = ("execute","fix"). Read .orchestrator/runs/*.jsonl rows (real shape: keys role, task, goal_id, lineage_root, provider, model, duration_s, usage or est_tokens, ts; look at real rows before coding, roles present today include execute, review, spec_review, scout, challenge, jev_route, planner_decision, memory) and .orchestrator/planner_usage.json plus scorecard._planner_usage_totals / _planner_runs_for_goal for Planner tokens (reuse, do not reimplement). for_goal(goal_id, root) -> {orchestration_tokens, execution_tokens, amplification (orchestration/execution, None when execution is 0), orchestration_usd, goal_usd, cost_share, orchestration_s, goal_s (wall clock from first to last run row of the goal's lineage), latency_share (sum of orchestration durations / goal_s), roles (per-role token and run counts), unattributed_tokens (rows without a goal)}. Tokens = total_tokens from bus.usage normalization when usage exists, else est_tokens. report(root, days=None) -> rows for every accepted goal (scorecard.accepted_goals) plus a totals line and medians. CLI: `orchestrator scorecard --overhead [--goal T-dddd] [--json]` in cli.py. Docs: docs/hermes-hardening/05-overhead.md with definitions and the real numbers measured on this repository (per accepted goal table; note that Planner tokens are attributed by planner_usage when available).
Repository rules: unittest (not pytest), tests/_harness.py single ORCH_ROOT fixture; every acceptance test id tests/test_<module>.py::test_name is a method def test_name(self) in a unittest.TestCase. No new third-party dependencies. Never write secret values to any file or log. Do not quote template placeholder tokens (double braces) anywhere in code comments or docs. Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh . until green; the base suite must stay green. Do not ask questions: decide, and note decisions in the result summary. Read docs/context-economy/00-overview.md only if you need the evidence/decision_log conventions.
acceptance: tests/test_overhead.py::test_for_goal_splits_roles_and_computes_ratios (synthetic rows for one goal: amplification, cost_share, latency_share, unattributed)
tests/test_overhead.py::test_report_over_real_run_rows (runs on this repository's real runs directory without raising and lists at least one accepted goal)
